purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA JMA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt software. It handles printing of monthly receipt (Rezept) data, specifically managing print jobs for medical insurance claim forms (both inpatient and outpatient variants). It reads print parameters, manages job control via a database, and outputs formatted print data to a print file.

notable_features: Extensive use of COPY statements for Japanese medical receipt form layouts (HCM/HCN series .INC files)
UNSTRING used to parse comma-delimited command parameters from LINKAGE SECTION
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for parameter passing
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (decoded as latin-1, showing mojibake)
No COMP-3 usage despite being a production financial/billing system
Multiple versioned copybooks (V01-V04 variants) for different form layouts
File STATUS fields for error handling
ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL for print output file
verdict.notes: The file contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but was decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake in comments and string literals. The program is clearly production medical billing software from the Japanese ORCA project (JMA Open Source medical receipt system), with a detailed revision history dating from 2000 to 2006. The source is truncated at 16000 chars but the structure is clear. The 'grpsys' prefix on some lines before COPY statements appears to be a group/section tag used by the build system.
